title: LuckRead Subscription D1-01 Logical Persistence Contract

authority.workerRuntimeBoundary: W07 Subscription workflow with explicitly admitted D1-01 access transition; W02 remains D1-01 Identity/Account/Access authority owner.

table.name: membership_subscriptions
table.purpose: Authoritative durable Subscription lifecycle state for Membership/Subscription access.

constraints.subscriptionIdUnique: subscription_id is the primary key and is never reused.
constraints.subscriberReference: subscriber_id references authoritative ENT-USER by stable identifier only; no cross-D1 physical foreign key.
constraints.planVersionReference: plan_id + plan_version identifies the immutable plan definition consumed by the subscription.
constraints.financialIsolation: No payment, order, ledger, wallet or settlement facts are persisted as Subscription authority.
constraints.entitlementIsolation: entitlement_snapshot_ref is a reference only; Entitlement remains its own authority.
constraints.privacy: subscriber_id is not a public identifier and must be exposed only through authorized scoped APIs.
constraints.versionMonotonic: version starts at 1 and increments exactly once per successful authoritative mutation.

concurrency.apiBoundary: If-Match / expected-version semantics from Membership API contract.
concurrency.decision: The Subscription entity field contract now defines version as the authoritative concurrency source. If-Match/expectedVersion MUST compare-and-set against this field; ETag remains representation metadata only.

uniqueness.reason: Membership Data Contract requires prevention of duplicate active subscriptions where business policy requires it, but the authoritative policy does not yet define whether the business key is subscriber-only, subscriber+plan, creator scope, organization scope, or another combination.
uniqueness.rule: No speculative unique constraint may be introduced until the applicable Membership policy/plan scope contract resolves the active-subscription uniqueness boundary.

migration.rule: The version-column migration is prepared as a reviewed code candidate only. A physical migration still requires exact artifact hash, read-only confirmation of the target and migration history, controlled target D1-01 execution and post-schema evidence. The paid upgrade attempt reservation is an auxiliary D1-01 workflow table with no financial fields; it remains PREPARED_NOT_APPLIED until exact target migration evidence is recorded. Scheduled downgrade requests add only future-dated lifecycle metadata to D1-01; the physical migration remains source-only until controlled target, migration-history and postflight evidence is admitted. Migration 0007 adds the typed DOWNGRADE/BILLING_INTERVAL_CHANGE discriminator to the scheduled-change metadata; it remains source-only until separately admitted and applied after 0006.

forbidden: Add a second Subscription authority in D1-04.
Store payment-provider secrets or raw payment credentials.
Create a speculative active-subscription uniqueness constraint.
Introduce a standalone version field without a field-contract change.
Treat cache, projection or analytics data as Subscription authority.
Execute or claim migration success from this logical contract.

migration artifact hash

promotionRule: Remain CONTRACTED_NOT_VERIFIED until the physical binding, migration, runtime authority and Evidence Registry evidence are all admitted.

additionalTables.name: membership_subscription_plan_change_attempts
additionalTables.purpose: Durable single-pending paid upgrade reservation and idempotency linkage. This is workflow metadata only and never an authority for price, tax, payment, refund or entitlement.
invariants: attempt_id is deterministically derived from subscriber-scoped Idempotency-Key using a one-way SHA-256 digest; raw idempotency keys are never stored.
At most one PENDING_PAYMENT upgrade attempt may exist per subscription.
A replay with the same subscriber and key returns the same opaque order reference; a semantically different replay conflicts.
Subscription mutation requires verified D1-04 payment success and a compare-and-set against expected subscription version, current plan/version and billing period.
order_id is only an opaque reference to D1-04 and does not make D1-01 a financial authority.
No monetary amount, currency, tax, discount, provider ID, payment status, refund or card data is stored in this table.
A paid upgrade applies only after its D1-03 W06 audit event is durably confirmed; otherwise webhook acknowledgement remains retryable.

additionalTables.name: membership_subscription_scheduled_plan_changes
additionalTables.purpose: Subscriber-owned future-dated plan downgrade or monthly/yearly billing-interval change. The current Subscription plan and entitlement remain unchanged until the existing renewal payment succeeds and its D1-04 outcome is synchronized.
invariants: change_id is deterministically derived from subscriber-scoped Idempotency-Key using SHA-256; raw idempotency keys are never stored.
Only an authenticated subscriber may schedule a plan downgrade or billing-interval change for their own ACTIVE, non-cancelled subscription using If-Match.

change_type is DOWNGRADE or BILLING_INTERVAL_CHANGE. DOWNGRADE requires the same creator, currency, and billing interval with a lower immutable plan-version price; BILLING_INTERVAL_CHANGE requires the same creator and currency with the opposite MONTHLY/YEARLY interval.

The scheduled change takes effect exactly at the current_period_end boundary; the live membership_subscriptions plan_id, plan_version and entitlement reference are not changed when the request is accepted.
No Order, PaymentIntent, charge, monetary amount, tax, discount, ledger or provider fact is created or persisted in D1-01 by scheduling a change.
At most one SCHEDULED plan change may exist per subscription; the same subscriber and key replays the same change.

The existing W07 renewal pipeline uses the scheduled immutable target plan version for the next cycle amount and billing interval; the selected target interval determines cycle_end while the current paid period remains unchanged.
A failed or unpaid renewal does not apply the scheduled change; it retains the target for a verified retry and otherwise remains reconciliation-owned.

D1-01 atomically applies the target plan identity, advances the period using the target interval, and marks the schedule APPLIED by subscription version CAS; W06 D1-03 audit confirmation is required before D1-04 renewal sync is acknowledged as complete.
